subject: Request: Pilot window extension & credit cushion for EdgeTech connector integration
messages:
From: Tariq Hassan <tariq@edgetech.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example
Cc: priya.rao@edgetech.ai, procure@edgetech.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause + ask for short extension

Hi Dylan,

Quick update from our side — the integration handoff hit an unexpected blocker. Our data team discovered schema drift in the customer event payloads after we started wiring the connector; the change requires a small transformation and a security review for the pipeline that won't clear until next week. Because of that we need to pause the pilot execution window and would like to request a short extension of the trial period (3 weeks) plus a modest credit cushion so our engineers can finish verification without the trial lapsing.

Attached is a short log snippet showing the failing event and the SSO approval ticket ID. Can Redwood help with a 21-day extension and a one-time sandbox credit for token consumption while we rework the adapter?

We appreciate the partnership — Tariq

Attachments: integration-log.txt (text, 18KB); pilot-scope-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.example
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq@edgetech.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause + ask for short extension

Tariq — thanks for the quick heads up and for the logs. Sorry to hear about the schema drift; sounds like a classic onboarding snag. We can absolutely look into an extension + credits. I'll do two things:

- Confirm internal approvals and get back with a concrete proposal (credits + extended end date) by EOD Monday.
- Share a short checklist for the transformation that our integration lead uses to speed verification.

Ben (AE) and Marissa (onboarding eng) are looped for scope and engineering context.

Quick Q: is the change limited to event schema (payload shape) or does it also affect auth header flow? If it's just payload shape we can probably grant the extension + a 50k token sandbox credit. If it touches auth we'll want to escalate to security for a fast review.

— Dylan

---
On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tariq Hassan <tariq@edgetech.ai> wrote:
> Hi Dylan,
> 
> Quick update from our side — the integration handoff hit an unexpected blocker...

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.example
To: ben_carter@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: EdgeTech trial extension / credit ask (schema drift)

Team — looping you in on the EdgeTech ask. Summary: production pilot scheduled to end 2026-08-31; customer found schema drift and needs ~3 weeks to finish adapter + security signoff. They've asked for a 21-day extension and an onetime token credit to cover verification runs. Attachments include their integration log and pilot scope.

Impact/why it matters: EdgeTech is a mid-market target with strong PLG usage potential; losing momentum here risks the Q4 expansion opportunity.

Recommendation: Grant 21-day extension + 50k token sandbox credit (one-time), contingent on an engineering checkpoint at +10 days. If auth changes are required we route to security and may delay credits until we have a green light.

Kimberly — can you approve the credits and extension or advise alternate amount? Ben, flag anything from a commercial/sales-ops perspective I should include in the offer email.

Thanks — Dylan

---
Attachments: integration-log.txt

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: EdgeTech trial extension / credit ask (schema drift)

Thanks for the summary, Dylan. Approve 21-day extension and a one-time sandbox credit of 50,000 tokens. Include the following conditions in the response to the customer:

1) Extension runs from the current pilot end date (2026-08-31) + 21 days; new end date = 2026-09-21.
2) Sandbox credit is for one-time use during the extension window and will not roll into production billing.
3) Engineering checkpoint at day 10 — Marissa to run a short verification call and confirm whether auth changes are needed.
4) If the security review finds auth or data-flow changes, credits will remain but further trials requiring security remediation will be paused until cleared.

Ben, please confirm we can reflect this in the deal record and no changes to discount tiers are required. Marissa, can you take the day-10 checkpoint and own the technical signoff?

— Kim

---
On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 08:22 AM dylan_brooks@redwood.example wrote:
> Team — looping you in on the EdgeTech ask...

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.example
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq@edgetech.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause + ask for short extension

Tariq — quick update and confirmation.

Good news: we can extend the pilot and provide the token cushion while you complete the adapter. Approved items below: 

- Extension: 21 days added to your pilot end date. Original end 2026-08-31 -> new end 2026-09-21.
- Sandbox credit: one-time 50,000 token credit available for use during the extension window.
- Checkpoint: Marissa (onboarding engineer) will run a verification call on 2026-08-31 (day 10 of the extension). If auth changes are required we will coordinate a fast security review, but credits will still be available.

Next steps for EdgeTech:
1) Confirm you accept the extension and credit terms by replying to this thread.
2) Share any updated payload examples and the auth ticket link before the day-10 checkpoint so Marissa can triage.
3) If you want the checkpoint earlier, propose a slot and Marissa will try to accommodate.

Happy to help get this unstuck — Dylan

---

> Thanks for the summary, Dylan. Approve 21-day extension and a one-time sandbox credit...
